mechanism: Amikacin may impair vitamin B12 absorption and cyanocobalamin may mask amikacin-induced peripheral neuropathy symptoms, complicating clinical assessment of aminoglycoside toxicity.
action: Monitor for signs of peripheral neuropathy and B12 deficiency; consider baseline and periodic B12 levels during prolonged amikacin therapy; assess neurological status carefully as cyanocobalamin may mask early aminoglycoside neurotoxicity.
